ocr_samples: だいたいドジっ娘だったら私の方が上だしっ
畜生風情がドジっ娘を気取るだと?
転移門にジャンプ入門してキリト君とぶつかって
胸まで探まれた私に死はないわっ!
translations: If I were the more clumsy girl, I’d be better off, right?
How dare he act like he’s a clumsy girl?
He jumped into the teleportation gate and bumped into Kitaro-kun.
With my chest exposed like this, I can’t die!
